body_markdown:
Sep 29, 2026


- [News Release](https://global.honda/en/newsroom/)


# Production, Sales and Export Results for August, 2026


-
-


Honda Motor Co., Ltd. today announced a summary of automobile production, Japan domestic sales, and export results for the month of August 2026.


#### World Production


August 2026 YOY August 2025


Japan 30,196 units 67.7% 44,586 units


Outside of Japan 203,192 units 91.4% 222,419 units


Total 233,388 units 87.4% 267,005 units


#### Production in Main Regions


North America 147,761 units 108.2% 136,559 units


USA 92,732 units 105.3% 88,056 units


Asia 43,377 units 56.4% 76,887 units


China 14,130 units 28.3% 50,011 units


##### August 2026


- Production in Japan: 1st YOY decrease in 9 months
- Production outside Japan: 8th consecutive month of YOY decrease
- Worldwide production: 7th consecutive month of YOY decrease


#### Sales in the Japanese Market


August 2026 YOY August 2025


Total 38,851 units 94.3% 41,220 units


Registrations 20,734 units 98.6% 21,038 units


Mini-vehicles 18,117 units 89.8% 20,182 units


##### August 2026


- Total sales in Japan: 1st YOY decrease in 5 months
- New vehicle registrations: 1st YOY decrease in 5 months
- Sales of mini-vehicles: 1st YOY decrease in 4 months


#### Exports from Japan


August 2026 YOY August 2025


Total 7,487 units 102.5% 7,307 units


North America 846 units 41.5% 2,037 units


USA 846 units 49.0% 1,727 units


Asia 640 units 231.0% 277 units


Europe 4,712 units 184.7% 2,551 units


Others 1,289 units 52.8% 2,442 units


##### August 2026


- Total exports from Japan: 1st YOY increase in 4 months
